patch.summary: Azure DevOps cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Azure DevOps pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. Free entry: Basic (first 5 users). 30-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.title: Azure DevOps plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

blocks.heading: Azure DevOps cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Azure DevOps against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Basic (first 5 users) until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (log management, source control and repos, CI/CD and automation) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: User 6 onwards is list price for every additional Basic seat — the free five are not a forever team cap workaround. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Microsoft/Azure-native engineering orgs requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: User 6 onwards is list price for every additional Basic seat — the free five are not a forever team cap workaround

blocks.title: Azure DevOps cost mistakes to avoid

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: User 6 onwards is list price for every additional Basic seat — the free five are not a forever team cap workaround

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Test Plans at list price is a QA licence, not something to assign to every developer

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Pipeline minutes and Artifacts storage are extra TCO beyond seats

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Not GitHub — Microsoft owns both; buying motions and community differ

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: GitHub Copilot is a separate AI-coding SKU — do not treat Azure DevOps as Copilot

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Azure DevOps on identical constraints.

blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for Azure DevOps alongside category cost modelling.
